strings.notes: placeholder contact 无名 ('nameless'); generic trainer call set, probably unused (no US counterpart)

strings.zh: 你挺能干的嘛！{NEWLINE}我好久没有输过了！{SCROLL}对了！{NEWLINE}我把电话号码给你吧。{SCROLL}有你在,我们就一定会有{NEWLINE}很多精彩的对战,{CLEAR}等我变强了再和你打电话！
strings.en: You’re pretty good! I{NEWLINE}haven’t lost in ages!{SCROLL}Oh, I know! Let me give{NEWLINE}you my phone number.{SCROLL}With you around, we’re sure to{NEWLINE}have loads of great battles. I’ll{CLEAR}call you once I get stronger!
Looks like you’re just{NEWLINE}a spineless loser...
strings.notes: tone review: 窝囊废 is a contemptuous 'spineless loser'; kept full strength (D-0627)

strings.zh: 你把电话号码给我吧。{SCROLL}有你在,我们就一定会有{NEWLINE}很多精彩的对战,{CLEAR}等我变强了再和你打电话！
strings.en: Give me your phone number.{SCROLL}With you around, we’re sure to{NEWLINE}have loads of great battles. I’ll{CLEAR}call you once I get stronger!

strings.zh: 可恶！{NEWLINE}你还是那么强⋯⋯{SCROLL}和{VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}进行了这么多场对战,{CLEAR}可一点胜算都没有⋯⋯{SCROLL}我买了那么多的药,{NEWLINE}经历了那么多的磨练,为什么？{SCROLL}难道说⋯⋯{NEWLINE}药的多少不代表一切⋯⋯{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}！这个给你！{NEWLINE}它对我来说已经没用了！
strings.en: Damn it! You’re as strong as ever...{SCROLL}I’ve had so many battles with you,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}, and never stood a chance...{SCROLL}I bought so much medicine and went{NEWLINE}through so much training. Why?{SCROLL}Could it be... that medicine{NEWLINE}isn’t everything...?{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}! Take this! It’s{NEWLINE}no use to me anymore!
strings.notes: tone review: 可恶 as an adult's 'Damn it!' (D-0627)

strings.zh: 喂喂,{VAR:0103:0}吗？{SCROLL}你干嘛？{NEWLINE}我们离得这么近,{CLEAR}直接和我说话好了啊！
strings.en: Hello, {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}What are you doing? We’re right next{NEWLINE}to each other. Just talk to me!

strings.zh: 喂喂,{VAR:0103:0}吗？{SCROLL}你怎么了？{NEWLINE}我们离得这么近,{CLEAR}直接和我说话好了啊！
strings.en: Hello, {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}What’s up? We’re right next to{NEWLINE}each other. Just talk to me!
